originalPlan.planTitle: Mani's 7-Day Metabolic Reset & Fat Loss Blueprint
originalPlan.planSummary: A balanced, progressive 7-day routine tailored for sustainable fat loss and muscle preservation at a medium intensity. Combining compound resistance training with targeted metabolic conditioning, this plan optimizes caloric expenditure while safeguarding joints and enhancing metabolic rate.

days.title: Full-Body Strength & Calorie Torch
days.warmup: 5-8 minutes: Arm circles, leg swings, bodyweight air squats, cat-cow stretch, and 2 minutes of light jumping jacks or brisk march.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell or Kettlebell)
exercises.notes: Keep chest elevated and brace core; choose a weight allowing solid form without knee valgus.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Press
exercises.notes: Retract scapulae and press up without locking elbows violently.

exercises.name: Supported Dumbbell Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull elbows toward your hips, pausing for 1 second at full contraction.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Hinge at the hips with a neutral spine; stop when hamstrings reach full tension.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.notes: Squeeze glutes and draw navel toward spine; avoid dipping lower back.

days.cooldown: 5 minutes: Standing quad stretch, cross-body shoulder stretch, downward dog, and deep diaphragmatic breathing.

days.title: Low-Impact Cardio & Core Stability
days.warmup: 5 minutes: Hip circles, high knees in place, torso twists, and ankle rotations.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Set incline between 6-8% at 4.5-5.5 km/h; maintain a steady conversational pace.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.notes: Reach opposite arm and leg straight without tilting pelvis; hold top position for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Deadbugs
exercises.notes: Press lower back firmly into the floor; move extremities slowly under control.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hold
exercises.notes: Align ankle, hip, and shoulder in one straight line; modify with bent knees if needed.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike Aerobic Flush
exercises.notes: Moderate resistance at 70-80 RPM to assist with lactate clearance.

days.cooldown: 6 minutes: Child's pose, cobra stretch, seated forward bend, and slow calf stretches.

days.title: Upper Body Sculpt & Posture Balance
days.warmup: 6 minutes: Band pull-aparts, thoracic spine rotations, shoulder dislocates with light band, wall angels.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown or Assisted Pull-up
exercises.notes: Focus on driving elbows straight down and squeezing the lats; avoid leaning back excessively.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Keep core tight to protect lower back; press dumbbells in an arc overhead.

exercises.name: Push-ups (Incline or Floor)
exercises.notes: Maintain a rigid plank; lower chest to about fist height from the ground.

exercises.name: Cable or Band Face Pulls
exercises.notes: Pull toward eye level, rotating forearms back to strengthen posterior delts and rotator cuff.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls superset with Cable Triceps Pushdowns
exercises.notes: Control tempo (2 seconds down, 1 second up); isolate biceps and triceps without swinging.

days.cooldown: 5 minutes: Doorway chest stretch, overhead triceps stretch, neck releases, and child's pose.

days.title: Active Recovery & Mobility Reset
days.focus: Hip Mobility, Spine Decompression, Joint Health
days.warmup: 3 minutes: Gentle walking and slow deep belly breathing.

exercises.name: Low-Intensity Outdoor Walk
exercises.notes: Casual, stress-free stroll at an easy pace to support circulation and NEAT (non-exercise activity thermogenesis).

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.notes: Move fluidly between lunge, thoracic reach, and hamstring extension.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose / Glute Stretch
exercises.notes: Sink hips comfortably toward floor; breathe deeply through tight spots.

exercises.name: Foam Rolling (Quads, IT Bands, Upper Back)
exercises.notes: Slow passes over tender areas, pausing for 20-30 seconds to release myofascial tension.

days.cooldown: 5 minutes: Legs-up-the-wall pose accompanied by relaxed slow nasal breathing.

days.title: Lower Body Power & Kinetic Chain Strength
days.warmup: 6 minutes: Glute bridges, bodyweight reverse lunges, standing knee hugs, ankle mobility drills.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Feel deep hamstring stretch; squeeze glutes at the top without hyperextending lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Step-Ups on Low Bench / Box
exercises.notes: Drive through the lead heel; minimize pushing off the ground with the trailing foot.

exercises.name: Leg Press or Supported Wall Sit
exercises.notes: Feet shoulder-width; lower weight with control to protect knee joints.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Squeeze
exercises.notes: Option to place a light dumbbell on hips; hold top peak contraction for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Full extension at the top and 2-second stretch at the bottom.

days.cooldown: 6 minutes: Seated butterfly stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch, standing calf wall stretch.

days.title: Metabolic Circuit & Functional Conditioning
days.warmup: 6 minutes: Jog in place, lateral lunges, inchworms, high knee taps, shoulder circles.

exercises.name: Kettlebell or Dumbbell Swings
exercises.notes: Power originates purely from explosive hip hinge, not shoulder lifting.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thrusters (Squat to Overhead Press)
exercises.notes: Use upward squat momentum to smoothly drive weights overhead; moderate load.

exercises.name: Renegade Rows (Kneeling or Plank)
exercises.notes: Widen stance to prevent hip rotation while rowing dumbbell to hip.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.notes: Keep hips low and drive knees rhythmically toward chest under control.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine or Elliptical Intervals
exercises.notes: Sustain a 7/10 RPE during work intervals, followed by gentle movement recovery.

days.cooldown: 6 minutes: Downward-facing dog into cobra, hamstring strap stretch, deep calming nasal breathing.

days.title: Full Rest & Nervous System Restoration
days.warmup: None required (pure restorative day).

exercises.name: Optional Casual Stroll
exercises.notes: Unstructured outdoor walking in fresh air for mild mood boost and blood flow; keep effort very light.

exercises.name: Static Full-Body Gentle Stretching
exercises.notes: Target tight spots from the week: calves, hips, lower back, and chest.

exercises.name: Guided Breathwork or Meditation
exercises.notes: Practice 4-second box breathing to downregulate the sympathetic nervous system.

days.cooldown: Hydrate adequately and complete evening wind-down routine.

originalPlan.nutritionTip: Target a moderate caloric deficit of ~400-500 kcal below your maintenance (aiming for roughly 2,000-2,100 kcal daily). Prioritize 1.6-1.8g of protein per kg of bodyweight (around 145-160g daily) distributed evenly across 3-4 meals to preserve lean mass and enhance satiety while in a deficit.
originalPlan.recoveryTip: At 28 years old and training at medium intensity, prioritize 7.5 to 8.5 hours of uninterrupted sleep; growth hormone peaks during deep stage-3 sleep, directly accelerating fat metabolism and muscle recovery. Drink at least 3-3.5 liters of water daily to support metabolic waste clearance.
originalPlan.coachingNotes: Mani, consistency crushes intensity every single time. At 90 kg, our primary aim is sustainable progression without overburdening your joints. Focus on textbook form and steady breathing, listen to your body on recovery days, and celebrate the small weekly non-scale victories!

originalPlan.planSummary: A customized 7-day fitness regimen built specifically for your goal of Weight Loss with a Medium intensity level. Incorporates progressive overload, structured metabolic conditioning, and essential recovery windows.

days.title: Full Body Awakening & Cardio Core
days.warmup: 5-10 mins: Arm swings, torso twists, 2 min jump rope or high knees

exercises.name: Standard Push-ups / Incline Push-ups
exercises.notes: Maintain strict neutral spine and full lockout

exercises.name: Dumbbell or Bodyweight Goblet Squats
exercises.notes: Drive knees outward and press through heels

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.notes: Resist hip sway and squeeze core tight

exercises.name: Walking Lunges with Torso Twist
exercises.notes: Maintain 90-degree knee bend

days.cooldown: 5-8 mins: Cobra stretch, child’s pose, doorway chest stretch

days.title: Lower Body Power & Posterior Chain
days.warmup: 5-8 mins: Leg swings (front/back & lateral), hip openers, bodyweight squats

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts (Dumbbell/Kettlebell/Band)
exercises.notes: Hinge deeply at hips, keep back flat

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats or Step-ups
exercises.notes: Controlled tempo, pause at bottom

exercises.name: Glute Bridges / Hip Thrusts
exercises.notes: Squeeze glutes at top for 2 full seconds

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Full extension onto balls of feet

days.cooldown: 6 mins: Seated hamstring stretch, pigeon pose, quadriceps stretch

days.title: Active Recovery & Mobility Flow
days.focus: Joint mobility, core de-loading and tissue regeneration
days.warmup: 5 mins: Cat-cow flow, thoracic rotations, deep breathing

exercises.name: Dynamic Vinyasa Flow or Gentle Yoga
exercises.notes: Focus on diaphragmatic breathing

exercises.name: Brisk Outdoor Walking or Light Cycling
exercises.notes: Zone 2 heart rate for aerobic base

exercises.name: Foam Rolling / Self-Myofascial Release
exercises.notes: Target IT band, upper back and calves

days.cooldown: 5 mins: Butterfly stretch and supine spinal twists

days.title: Metabolic HIIT & Core Conditioning
days.focus: Lats, rhomboids, biceps and cardiovascular endurance
days.warmup: 6 mins: Arm circles, band pull-aparts, light shadow boxing

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows / Resistance Band Rows
exercises.notes: Pull elbow toward hip pocket without shrugging

exercises.name: Banded Face Pulls or Rear Delt Flyes
exercises.notes: Promotes healthy rotator cuff posture

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.notes: Slow and controlled rotation

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers or Burpees
exercises.notes: Keep steady pacing throughout

days.cooldown: 6 mins: Lat stretch against wall, cross-body shoulder stretch

days.title: Full Body Functional Complex & Stamina
days.focus: Compound functional movement and total body strength
days.warmup: 7 mins: Jumping jacks, inchworms with push-up, torso circles

exercises.name: Thrusters (Squat to Overhead Press)
exercises.notes: Use lower body drive to power weight overhead

exercises.name: Kettlebell / Dumbbell Swings
exercises.notes: Explosive hip hinge, do not squat the weight

exercises.name: Bear Crawl Holds or Bird Dogs
exercises.notes: Keep back flat like a tabletop

exercises.name: Side Plank Holds
exercises.notes: Stack feet or drop bottom knee if needed

days.cooldown: 8 mins: Child’s pose, world’s greatest stretch, deep hip flexor stretch

days.title: Cardio Engine, Core & Agility Drill
days.focus: Aerobic threshold, speed-agility, and mental resilience
days.warmup: 6 mins: High knees, butt kicks, lateral shuffles

exercises.name: Interval Jogging / Sprint Intervals or Rower
exercises.notes: Adjust pace according to perceived exertion

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises / Lying Leg Lifts
exercises.notes: Engage lower abdominals without swinging

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.notes: Chest proud, feet slightly elevated

days.cooldown: 6 mins: Standing quad stretch, calves wall stretch, slow walking

days.title: Deep Rest, Central Nervous System Recovery & Reset
days.focus: Cellular recovery, glycogen replenishment, and mental preparation
days.warmup: None needed - complete rest

exercises.name: Gentle Walk in Nature / Leisure Stroll
exercises.notes: Purely leisurely; avoid intense elevation

exercises.name: Full Body Passive Stretching & Breathwork
exercises.notes: 4 seconds in, 7 seconds hold, 8 seconds out

days.cooldown: Hydrate well with electrolytes, take a warm epsom salt bath if available

originalPlan.nutritionTip: Maintain a modest caloric deficit of 300-500 kcal daily. Prioritize lean protein with fibrous green vegetables at every meal, drink at least 2.5 to 3 liters of water, and eliminate liquid sugars.
originalPlan.recoveryTip: Prioritize 7.5 to 9 hours of uninterrupted sleep every night. Muscle repair, hormone balance, and nervous system recovery occur primarily during slow-wave deep sleep.
originalPlan.coachingNotes: Always listen to your body. Consistency over 4 to 8 weeks compounds into transformative results. Progress weights or reps gradually.

originalPlan.planTitle: Kavita's Hypertrophy Surge: 7-Day High-Intensity Muscle Build
originalPlan.planSummary: This high-intensity program utilizes progressive overload and metabolic stress to stimulate significant muscle fiber hypertrophy. By alternating compound lifting days with active recovery, we optimize protein synthesis and hormonal response for lean muscle gains.

days.title: Lower Body Power
days.warmup: 5 min light jog, 2 min leg swings, 3 min bodyweight squats and lunges

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squats
exercises.notes: Keep chest up, drive through the heels, maintain neutral spine

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts
exercises.notes: Focus on the hinge movement, feel the stretch in hamstrings

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Do not lock out knees at the top to keep tension on quads

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: Keep core braced to maintain balance

days.cooldown: 5 min static stretching targeting quads, hamstrings, and glutes

days.title: Upper Body Push
days.warmup: 5 min arm circles, cat-cow stretches, and resistance band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Control the descent for 2 seconds to maximize time under tension

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Avoid arching the lower back; engage glutes for stability

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.notes: Maintain a slight bend in elbows, focus on chest contraction

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdowns
exercises.notes: Keep elbows tucked to your sides

days.cooldown: 5 min chest and shoulder static stretching

days.title: Active Recovery
days.warmup: None

exercises.name: Brisk Walking or Light Yoga
exercises.notes: Keep heart rate low; focus on deep breathing and recovery

days.cooldown: Full body foam rolling

days.title: Upper Body Pull
days.warmup: 5 min rowing machine, shoulder rolls, and scapular retractions

exercises.name: Bent Over Barbell Rows
exercises.notes: Lead with your elbows, squeeze shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.notes: Full range of motion, avoid leaning back excessively

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.notes: Pull towards eyes, rotate hands externally

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Keep upper arms stationary throughout the movement

days.cooldown: 5 min lat and forearm stretches

days.title: Full Body Hypertrophy
days.warmup: 5 min dynamic warm-up: jumping jacks, arm swings, high knees

exercises.name: Deadlifts
exercises.notes: Focus on form, keep the bar close to your shins

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squats
exercises.notes: Hold weight at chest level, keep torso upright

exercises.name: Pushups
exercises.notes: Keep a straight line from head to heels

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Squeeze glutes and abs hard

days.cooldown: Full body static stretching

days.title: Cardio & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cycling

exercises.name: HIIT Intervals (Cycling or Running)
exercises.notes: Push intensity to 90% during sprints

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.notes: Avoid using momentum to swing legs

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.notes: Rotate your torso, not just your arms

days.cooldown: 5 min light yoga flow

days.title: Full Rest
days.warmup: None
days.cooldown: None

originalPlan.nutritionTip: Consume 1.6g to 2g of protein per kg of body weight daily and ensure a slight caloric surplus (200-300 kcal above maintenance) to fuel muscle repair and growth.
originalPlan.recoveryTip: At 29, your recovery is efficient but requires consistency; aim for 7-9 hours of sleep and prioritize magnesium-rich foods or supplementation to reduce muscle soreness after high-intensity sessions.
originalPlan.coachingNotes: Kavita, you have the drive to succeed! Remember that muscle is built during rest, not just in the gym. If you feel excessive fatigue, listen to your body and adjust intensity. Form over weight always—stay consistent and keep pushing!
